Versamet Royalties Reports Q3 2026 Results


All amounts are in U.S. dollars unless otherwise indicated.


Vancouver, British Columbia–(Newsfile Corp. – November 10, 2026) – Versamet Royalties Corporation (NASDAQ: VMET) (TSX: VMET) (“Versamet” or the “Company”) announces operating and financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Q3 2026 Financial Highlights**


- Revenue of $21.1 million, an increase of 160% over Q3 2025.
- Attributable gold equivalent ounces1 (“GEOs”) of 4,959, an increase of 84% over Q3 2025.
- Cash flow from operations before working capital changes2 of $18.1 million, an increase of 196% over Q3 2025.
- Net income of $4.1 million, an increase of 23% over Q3 2025.
- Adjusted EBITDA3 of $17.9 million, an increase of 212% over Q3 2025.


Dan O’Flaherty, CEO of Versamet, commented: “The third quarter reflected material progress across our portfolio. Our producing assets performed well highlighted by increased gold production at Kiaka (13% over the prior quarter) and record monthly production at Santa Rita as Appian approaches a final investment decision on the underground. We expect our portfolio to have a strong finish to 2026 and we reiterate our guidance for the year.


“Our next wave of growth is taking shape as our operating partners advance key projects that will expand our production profile in both the near and long term. Rosh Pinah’s RP 2.0 expansion is in the final phase of construction, Cuiú Cuiú poured first gold ahead of schedule in September, and Blackwater’s Phase 1A expansion remains on track for completion this quarter. Eskay Creek continues to advance toward first ore in 2027, with construction over 80% complete as of the end of October, while Southern Copper has begun early site works at El Pilar. Further strengthening our growth pipeline, new economic studies were completed for PC Silver and Zuun Mod, and SSR Mining’s acquisition of Converse provides a clear path to production for the project.


“Versamet was also added to the GDXJ in September, one of the major indices for mining equities, marking another important milestone in the advancement of our capital markets profile.”

**Asset Updates (Producing Assets)**


Kiaka (2.7% NSR Royalty)


Kiaka delivered strong operational performance in Q3 2026 with record gold production of 76,030 ounces, a 13% increase over the previous quarter. The increase was driven by a 15% increase in mill throughput, to 2.87 million tonnes at an average head grade of 0.9 g/t and recovery of 93.1%. West African Resources sold 73,492 ounces of gold from Kiaka during the quarter and held 20,861 ounces of unsold gold bullion at the end of the quarter, which Versamet expects to contribute to GEOs in subsequent quarters. Kiaka is expected to produce between 240,000 and 280,000 ounces of gold in 2026.4


Rosh Pinah (90% Silver Stream)


In Q3 2026, the Company recorded 455 GEOs from sales of silver deliveries from Rosh Pinah. The RP2.0 expansion project continues to advance and is now in the final phase of its construction.5


Greenstone (1.26% Gold Stream)


Greenstone produced 60,596 ounces of gold in Q3 2026 with the plant processing 2.2 million tonnes at an average grade of 1.03 g/t. Equinox Gold expects stronger production at Greenstone through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. Attributable production from Greenstone totaled 1,050 gold ounces in Q3 2026.6


Kolpa (95.8% Copper Stream)


In Q3 2026, the Company recorded 744 GEOs from sales of copper deliveries from Kolpa, its highest quarterly GEOs since acquiring the stream in 2025. Kolpa processed 256,052 tonnes in Q3 2026, up 10% from 233,408 tonnes in Q2 2026. The increase reflects the continued benefit of the plant expansion to 2,500 tonnes per day, commissioned at the end of Q1 2026.7


Santa Rita (2.75% NSR Royalty)


In Q3 2026, the Company recorded 416 GEOs from royalty revenue from Santa Rita. In August 2026, Santa Rita produced a record 12,464 tonnes of nickel concentrate. Metallurgical recovery was also a record, at 86.72%. Both are the highest levels since Appian restarted the mine in 2019.


Santa Rita continues to advance the transition from open-pit to underground operations, which is expected to extend the mine’s operating life beyond 30 years and produce approximately 30,000 tonnes of nickel equivalent per year. Appian is advancing the Definitive Feasibility Study in parallel with initial underground works, which began in March 2026 and have now excavated over 600 meters of tunnels.8


Cuiú Cuiú (1.5% NSR Royalty)


On September 10, 2026, Cabral Gold announced the first gold pour at Cuiú Cuiú, producing approximately 1,130 ounces during wet circuit commissioning, and a total of 2,400 oz sold during the quarter. Cabral is ramping up mining and ore stacking towards 3,000 tonnes per day, targeting commercial production and announcing an updated mineral resource estimate before year end.9


**Asset Updates (Development Assets)**


Eskay Creek (3.52% Gold Stream)


Construction at Eskay Creek was over 80% complete as of the end of October, up from 62% at June 30, 2026. Skeena Gold & Silver continues to target first ore in Q2 2027. Skeena also plans an updated technical study in early 2027.10


El Pilar (1% GR Royalty)


On October 20, 2026, Southern Copper reported that early site preparation at El Pilar began in September 2026, and that it has signed basic engineering contracts for the project’s access road, railway spur, substations and power lines. Construction is expected to begin in Q1 2027, with production expected to begin in the second half of 2029. Once in production, El Pilar is expected to produce 36,000 tonnes of copper cathode per year over an 18-year mine life.11


Converse (1% NSR Royalty)


On October 13, 2026, SSR Mining agreed to acquire Roxmore Resources, with closing expected in Q4 2026, subject to approval by Roxmore shareholders, court approval and other customary conditions. SSR plans to develop Converse as an extension of its adjacent Marigold Complex, targeting 150,000 to 170,000 ounces of gold per year over a 10+ year mine life from 2033.12


PC Silver (1.2% NSR Royalty)


On September 17, 2026, Honey Badger Silver released an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment (“PEA”) and Mineral Resource Estimate for the PC Silver project. The PEA contemplates a 22-year underground operation mining approximately 2,400 tonnes per day. Average annual payable production over the life of mine is approximately 2.5 million ounces of silver, 117 million pounds of zinc, 95 million pounds of lead and 1.3 million pounds of copper. Honey Badger is targeting completion of a feasibility study in Q2 2027.13


Zuun Mod (1.5% NSR Royalty)


On October 14, 2026, Erdene Resource released a PEA for its Zuun Mod project. The PEA outlines a 34-year molybdenum-copper operation with average annual production of approximately 19.8 million pounds of molybdenum and 27.9 million pounds of copper. Erdene is in discussions regarding offtake, financing and strategic partnerships, and plans to begin drilling in late October 2026.14

**Non-IFRS Financial Measures**


The Company has included certain performance measures in this press release that do not have any standardized meaning prescribed by International Financial Reporting Standards (“IFRS”) including (a) GEOs and total attributable GEOs, (b) operating cash flows before working capital changes, and (c) EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA. The Company believes that, in addition to conventional measures prepared in accordance with IFRS, certain investors use this information to evaluate the Company’s performance and ability to generate cash flow.


**Third-Party Information**

The Company is dependent on (i) the operators of the mines or properties and their Qualified Persons to provide technical or other information to the Company, or (ii) publicly available information to prepare disclosure pertaining to properties and operations on the mines or properties on which the Company holds a royalty, stream or other interest, and generally has limited or no ability to independently verify such information. **Endnotes**


1. Attributable Gold Equivalent Ounces is calculated by converting the Company’s royalty revenue and stream sales to a GEO basis by dividing the royalty revenue plus stream sales for a period by the average gold price based on the LBMA Gold Price PM Fix per ounce for the same respective period. Total Attributable GEOs sold includes the GEOs from the Company’s royalty revenue and stream sales, plus the gold ounces sold from the Greenstone gold interest and Santa Rita royalty amounts received related to the period between the effective date of the contract and closing of the agreement, which have been treated as an adjustment to the purchase consideration for accounting. Management believes that adjusting for these amounts more accurately depicts GEOs attributable to the Company. The Company presents Total Attributable GEOs as it believes that this is useful information to allow investors to evaluate the Company’s performance in comparison to other streaming and royalty companies in the precious metals mining industry that present results on a similar basis.
